facts.quote: The King has been pleased to appoint Mr William James Baxter QPM DL as His Majesty’s Lord-Lieutenant of County Tyrone
facts.statement: The King appointed William James Baxter as Lord-Lieutenant of County Tyrone.
Sir Robert William Lowry Scott retired from the office of Lord-Lieutenant of County Tyrone on 17 June 2026.

facts.quote: served in the RUC/PSNI from 1973 until his retirement in 2003
facts.statement: William James Baxter served in the RUC/PSNI from 1973 until his retirement in 2003.

facts.quote: was District Commander in Omagh from 1997
facts.statement: William James Baxter was District Commander in Omagh from 1997.

facts.quote: Mr Baxter has served as Sheriff for County Tyrone in 2013
facts.statement: William James Baxter served as Sheriff for County Tyrone in 2013.

facts.quote: Mr Baxter has served as Deputy Lieutenant of County Tyrone for 14 years
facts.statement: William James Baxter has served as Deputy Lieutenant of County Tyrone for 14 years.
